method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Original first two years retained; Johnson had served less than one complete year by the 1964 election. Medicare remained a proposal.
Original Baker trial retained; note distinguishes 1963-64 Senate hearings from later 1967 criminal trial.
Original helping found Arizona NAACP chapter retained as candidate claim; primary Civil Rights Act source does not independently prove this precise biography detail.

revisions.source: Hubert Humphrey has served Minnesota with honor and pride, and I’m certain he’ll carry that drive and motivation with us to the White House.
revisions.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱一直满怀荣誉感和自豪感，为明尼苏达州服务。我确信，他会带着同样的干劲和热情，与我们一道进入白宫。

revisions.source: Everyone knows what I want already. Let's talk about Goldwater, his extremism, and how he's completely unfit for office- that should get them worked up.
revisions.zh: 大家早就知道我想做什么了。我们来谈戈德华特，谈他的极端立场，以及他为什么完全不适合担任总统。这应该能让他们激动起来。

revisions.source: Let's focus on the Great Society- Medicare, Social Security expansions, and the Civil Rights Act. These are all things I have championed in my first two years, and I will champion them further in my next four.
revisions.zh: 我们重点谈伟大社会：老年医疗保险、扩大社会保障，以及《民权法案》。这些都是我执政头两年一直倡导的政策，接下来的四年我还会进一步推动。

revisions.source: Let's give them a real show- promise expansions to Civil Rights, more Social Security and welfare expansions, and a continued commitment to liberal ideals.
revisions.zh: 我们给他们来场真正精彩的演说：承诺进一步推动民权、扩大社会保障和福利，并继续坚持自由主义理想。

revisions.source: We need to go the other way for now. Talk about moderacy and reason, continued respect of the rights of the states, and promise to win in Vietnam and keep inflation low.
revisions.zh: 眼下我们得换个方向。谈温和与理性、继续尊重各州权利，并承诺赢得越南战争、维持低通胀。

revisions.source: He should stick to movies if he has any sense.
revisions.zh: 他要是有点脑子，就该继续拍电影。

revisions.source: The Midwest is critical to our success in this election, and we can't take any chances. Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio will be good hosts for our final few rallies.
revisions.zh: 中西部对我们赢得这次选举至关重要，不能冒任何风险。最后几场集会，放在伊利诺伊州、印第安纳州和俄亥俄州很合适。

revisions.source: The Deep South has been Goldwater's stronghold this whole election, but they're Democrats at heart. We'll swing through Mississippi, Alabama, and Georgia to wrap this up.
revisions.zh: 整个选举期间，深南部一直是戈德华特的堡垒，但那里的人骨子里还是民主党人。我们到密西西比州、阿拉巴马州和佐治亚州转一圈，结束竞选。

revisions.source: The Rockies have had some alarming polling numbers recently. We should roll through there and make sure they're still on our side, before making a final stop in California.
revisions.zh: 最近，落基山地区的民调有些令人担忧。我们应到那里走一趟，确保他们仍站在我们这边，最后再停留加利福尼亚州。

revisions.source: The Plains have been a bit rocky in their support for us recently. We'll go through there and secure their votes.
revisions.zh: 最近，大平原地区对我们的支持有些摇摆。我们去那里走一趟，稳住他们的选票。

revisions.source: Those damn conmen!
revisions.zh: 那些该死的骗子！

revisions.source: If he keeps talking like that, we won’t even need to campaign.
revisions.zh: 他要是继续这么说，我们连竞选都不用了。

revisions.source: We have had a draft in place for decades. I will not accept cowardice as an excuse among the young men of America.
revisions.zh: 我们实行征兵制度已经几十年了。我不接受美国年轻人拿怯懦当借口。

revisions.source: Your liberal base is fired up at your idealistic plans, but moderates are wary of further expansions to these programs, and Southern Democrats are offput entirely.
revisions.zh: 你的理想主义计划鼓舞了自由派基本盘，但温和派对进一步扩大这些项目心存疑虑，南方民主党人则完全被你推开了。

revisions.source: Pundits are unsurprised by your campaign taking swings at Goldwater right out the gate, but it's having its intended effect.
revisions.zh: 评论员对你的竞选一开始就攻击戈德华特毫不意外，不过这些攻击正在达到预期效果。

revisions.source: This moderate turn is welcomed by moderates and Southern Democrats alike, making up ground among them- but liberal supporters are very deflated at your seeming abandonment of the issues they champion.
revisions.zh: 这次转向温和路线，同时受到温和派和南方民主党人的欢迎，你在他们当中追回了一些支持；不过，你似乎抛弃了自由派支持者珍视的议题，让他们十分泄气。

revisions.source: Pointing at your accomplishments elevates the tone of the campaign, as well as adding a nice sheen to your image.
revisions.zh: 强调你的政绩，提高了竞选的格调，也让你的形象更加光彩。

revisions.source: By leaning full-force into Humphrey’s record, you’ve fired up your liberal base- at the expense of your chances at winning the South back from Goldwater. Of course, with the lead you’ve started with, does it matter?
revisions.zh: 你全力强调汉弗莱的政绩，鼓舞了自由派基本盘，却牺牲了从戈德华特手中夺回南方的机会。当然，考虑到你一开始就有的领先优势，这重要吗？

revisions.source: Some notice a bit of hesitancy to touch on Humphrey’s record with this response, sparking rumors that you plan to run a moderate campaign this election season. This is a bit deflating to your liberal base.
revisions.zh: 有人从这个回答中察觉到，你对谈论汉弗莱的政绩有些迟疑，于是传出流言，称你打算在本次竞选走温和路线。这让自由派基本盘有些泄气。

revisions.source: Goldwater’s famous slips of the tongue will provide your attack ads with all the ammunition they can ever need throughout this campaign.
revisions.zh: 戈德华特那些出名的失言，将为你整个竞选期间的攻击广告提供用不完的素材。

revisions.source: Analysts are surprised at your refusal to go low against Goldwater. These ads are effective enough but some advisors think you’re leaving some of your most potent arguments on the table by taking the high road.
revisions.zh: 分析人士惊讶于你不肯用卑劣手段攻击戈德华特。这些广告效果还算不错，但一些顾问认为，选择堂堂正正的路线，等于放弃了某些最有力的攻击点。

revisions.source: Despite your best efforts, the Bobby Baker trial remains as an ugly mark for Goldwater to needle you on.
revisions.zh: 尽管你已竭尽全力，博比·贝克的审判仍然是一处难看的污点，让戈德华特能够继续拿来刺痛你。

revisions.source: They say discretion is the better part of valor, but allowing the rift to grow wider might spell doom in future elections. Thankfully, with how you’re polling in the rest of the country, it shouldn’t be an issue for you.
revisions.zh: 俗话说，谨慎也是勇气的一部分。不过，任由裂痕扩大，可能会给今后的选举埋下祸根。好在你在全国其他地区的民调表现很好，这对你应该不成问题。

revisions.source: On the upside, hesitant Southern Democrats are eagerly throwing their support behind you. On the downside, liberals and Humphrey suspect that something’s up, hurting your numbers across the North.
revisions.zh: 好的一面是，原本犹豫的南方民主党人正热切地转而支持你；坏的一面是，自由派和汉弗莱怀疑你另有盘算，使你在整个北方的支持率下降。

revisions.source: This is a very disappointing answer to liberals and activists alike, not least of which is your running mate Humphrey, but it may win over wary moderates- and it certainly won’t push Southern Democrats further away.
revisions.zh: 这个回答让自由派和活动家都十分失望，尤其是你的竞选搭档汉弗莱。不过，它也许能争取谨慎的温和派，肯定也不会让南方民主党人离你更远。

revisions.source: Humphrey is more than happy with this, as are African-Americans and liberals across the country. However, moderates who were wary of the first Civil Rights Act recoil at the idea of a second, more radical one- and Southern Democrats are practically frothing at the mouth at the news.
revisions.zh: 汉弗莱对此十分满意，全国各地的非裔美国人和自由派也是如此。不过，原本就对第一项《民权法案》心存疑虑的温和派，一听到还要推出第二项、更激进的法案便退缩了；南方民主党人听到消息，简直气得口吐白沫。

revisions.source: This kind of answer angers nobody, but it doesn’t particularly please anyone either. Perhaps some moderates in border states will be swayed.
revisions.zh: 这种回答不会惹恼谁，但也没让谁特别满意。也许边界州的一些温和派会被说动。

revisions.source: Bobby Baker was a protege and good friend of yours, and your business connections with both men in the 50’s have been widely publicized. Your numbers take a big hit as both Goldwater and the press rakes you for this outright lie. Best hope this blows over soon...
revisions.zh: 博比·贝克是你提携的后辈，也是你的好友；你在上世纪50年代与这两人的商业关联，早已被广泛报道。戈德华特和媒体抓住这句赤裸裸的谎言猛烈抨击，你的支持率遭到重创。最好盼着风波快点过去……

revisions.source: Your openness surprises many analysts, but perhaps the impact of the scandal is lessened by your honesty? It’s hard to say.
revisions.zh: 你的坦诚让许多分析人士感到意外，不过，诚实也许减轻了丑闻的冲击？很难说。

revisions.source: 'Confessions Of A Republican', as it’s called, is making waves across the North in moderate Republican circles.
revisions.zh: 这则名为《一个共和党人的自白》的广告，正在北方温和派共和党人中引起轰动。

revisions.source: Richard Nixon’s voice still holds sway, and Goldwater’s numbers see a rise- at your expense. Hopefully, he won’t run in 1968.
revisions.zh: 理查德·尼克松说话仍然有影响力，戈德华特的支持率上升，而代价由你承担。希望他不会在1968年参选。

revisions.source: Unfortunately, this probably puts South Carolina out of reach for your campaign.
revisions.zh: 遗憾的是，这很可能让你的阵营失去拿下南卡罗来纳州的机会。

revisions.source: Moderates like this appeal, even if it disappoints liberals and activists nationwide. Will it be enough to push you over the top?
revisions.zh: 温和派喜欢这一呼吁，尽管它让全国各地的自由派和活动家失望。这足以让你取得最后的胜利吗？

revisions.source: Liberals and activists are ecstatic with this answer, even as moderates shy away and Southern Democrats rage. Will their enthusiasm be enough?
revisions.zh: 自由派和活动家为这个回答欣喜若狂，温和派却退缩了，南方民主党人更是怒不可遏。他们的热情够用吗？

revisions.source: Southern Democrats are reassured by your last-minute appeal, even if liberals and activists are infuriated by your flip-flopping. Will the South carry you to victory?
revisions.zh: 你在最后关头的呼吁让南方民主党人放心了，尽管自由派和活动家对你的反复无常十分愤怒。南方会把你送上胜利的宝座吗？

revisions.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1964 Republican nomination for President! As you take the stage to cheers and applause from one side of the floor- and stony silence from the other- what will you touch on in your acceptance speech?
revisions.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了1964年共和党总统候选人提名！你登上讲台，大会一侧欢呼鼓掌，另一侧却冷若冰霜、默不作声。你准备在接受提名演说中谈些什么？

revisions.source: Why did you pick Bill Miller as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 你为什么选择比尔·米勒作为竞选搭档？

revisions.source: A new wave of attack ads have gone out across the nation, highlighting Johnson’s involvement with Bobby Baker and Bill Sol Estes.
revisions.zh: 新一轮攻击广告已在全国播出，着重强调约翰逊与博比·贝克及比利·索尔·埃斯蒂斯的关联。

revisions.source: Your nomination has scared off moderates in the Republican Party, with several Republicans such as George Romney and Nelson Rockefeller refusing to endorse you. How will you unite your party?
revisions.zh: 你的提名吓跑了共和党内的温和派，乔治·罗姆尼、纳尔逊·洛克菲勒等共和党人都拒绝为你背书。你准备如何团结全党？

revisions.source: Your civil rights position is the most controversial part of your campaign. Would you like to clarify your position to help ease the fears of Southern Democrats or Northern moderates?
revisions.zh: 你的民权立场，是竞选中最有争议的部分。你想进一步说明自己的立场，缓解南方民主党人或北方温和派的担忧吗？

revisions.source: Dwight D. Eisenhower is a very popular figure in the Midwest and Plains, but not as popular in the South. You’ve recently filmed a television ad appearing with Eisenhower. Where and how frequently would you like to air this ad?
revisions.zh: 德怀特·D. 艾森豪威尔在中西部和大平原地区十分受欢迎，但在南方没那么受欢迎。你最近与他共同拍摄了一则电视广告。你希望在哪些地区播放，播放频率又如何？

revisions.source: Lyndon Johnson has attacked our record on social security greatly, even running an ad where our own running mate Bill Miller says we wish to destroy the social security system! How should we fight back against these ads?
revisions.zh: 林登·约翰逊猛烈攻击我们在社会保障问题上的立场，甚至播出一则广告，让我们自己的竞选搭档比尔·米勒说出，我们想摧毁社会保障制度！我们该怎样反击这些广告？

revisions.source: Hubert Humphrey is another weakspot of Lyndon Johnson's, we could try to attack his running mate to gain an edge in the poll to hopefully swing more conservative-aligned moderates to our side.
revisions.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱也是林登·约翰逊的一个弱点。我们可以试着攻击他的竞选搭档，在民调中取得优势，希望能把更多倾向保守主义的温和派争取过来。

revisions.source: Another day, another speech. What will you say today on the campaign trail?
revisions.zh: 又是新的一天，又有一场演说。今天你在竞选途中准备说些什么？

revisions.source: There's been a lot of talk from your camp about cutting spending to reduce the growing inflation, what programs would you have in mind?
revisions.zh: 你的阵营一直在谈削减开支，以降低不断上升的通胀。你具体想削减哪些项目？

revisions.source: Goldwater has received an endorsement from the leader of the Alabama Ku Klux Klan. LBJ has already capitalized with attack ads going out nationwide. What should we do?
revisions.zh: 戈德华特得到了阿拉巴马州三K党领导人的支持。约翰逊已借题发挥，在全国播出攻击广告。我们该怎么办？

revisions.source: Goldwater has been seen as the candidate of the John Birch Society, a fervent group of anti-communist conspiracy theorists. What should we do about this?
revisions.zh: 戈德华特被视为约翰·伯奇协会的候选人，这是一个狂热的反共阴谋论者团体。我们该怎么办？

revisions.source: Having recently received endorsements from the Ku Klux Klan and the John Birch Society, you need to find a way to distance yourself from extremists and put yourself into the American political mainstream.
revisions.zh: 你最近得到了三K党和约翰·伯奇协会的支持，需要想办法与极端分子保持距离，让自己回到美国政治主流之中。

revisions.source: Vermont and Indiana are key states for any Republican to win. Would you like to put campaign efforts into winning these states?
revisions.zh: 佛蒙特州和印第安纳州，都是共和党人争取胜利的关键州。你想投入竞选力量，拿下这两个州吗？

revisions.source: The 1964 Campaign is drawing to a close, and chances don’t look good for Goldwater’s success. Are there any last minute statements you’d like to make to win voters over?
revisions.zh: 1964年竞选即将结束，戈德华特获胜的前景并不乐观。你想在最后关头发表什么声明，争取选民吗？

revisions.source: Where would you like to campaign on the last day before election day?
revisions.zh: 在选举日前的最后一天，你想到哪里竞选？

revisions.source: Let it be known that I side with the states on the civil rights issue. I will not change this.
revisions.zh: 我要让大家知道，在民权问题上，我站在各州这一边。这个立场不会改变。

revisions.source: I would like to clarify in regards to the Civil Rights Act of 1964. Despite my vote against the bill, I will uphold it as President. I would like to see it repealed- I still believe it is unconstitutional- but a President cannot ignore laws that he dislikes.
revisions.zh: 我想澄清对1964年《民权法案》的立场。虽然我投票反对这项法案，但担任总统后，我会执行它。我仍认为它违宪，希望将它废除，但总统不能无视自己不喜欢的法律。

revisions.source: I would like to change my previous position. With the passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, I shall make no attempt to remove this law, but I will oppose further legislation, such as mass busing or forced integration.
revisions.zh: 我想改变此前的立场。1964年《民权法案》既已通过，我不会试图废除它。不过，我会反对进一步立法，例如大规模跨区校车接送或强制种族融合。

revisions.source: Bill Miller is a devout Catholic, a good man, and he has served New York with honor and distinction.
revisions.zh: 比尔·米勒是一位虔诚的天主教徒，是个好人。他为纽约州服务，表现光荣而卓越。

revisions.source: Miller and I agree on just about everything. I chose him because I believe we represent the future of this country.
revisions.zh: 米勒和我几乎在所有事情上都意见一致。我选择他，是因为我相信，我们代表着这个国家的未来。

revisions.source: We need to emphasize that Humphrey and Johnson are nothing but socialists and puppets of big union bosses.
revisions.zh: 我们需要强调，汉弗莱和约翰逊不过是社会主义者，是大工会头目的傀儡。

revisions.source: There may be differences between our wings of the party, but we must remember that we are all Republicans, and we stand united in our common goals.
revisions.zh: 党内各派也许有分歧，但我们必须记住，大家都是共和党人，都为共同的目标团结奋斗。

revisions.source: Ike is too popular not to have this playing in every household.
revisions.zh: 艾克如此受欢迎，这则广告非得让家家户户都看到不可。

revisions.source: Limit this ad to the Plains and Midwest. Ike enjoys the most popularity there.
revisions.zh: 只在大平原和中西部播放这则广告。艾克在那里最受欢迎。

revisions.source: Damn those TV ads!
revisions.zh: 那些该死的电视广告！

revisions.source: We need to double-down on the states rights issue. Our only hope of victory is through the South.
revisions.zh: 我们必须更坚定地强调州权议题。取胜的唯一希望，就是南方。

revisions.source: Social Security is a winning issue. In these final days, we must expose Johnson’s lies about our opinion on the subject, and turn the tables back on him.
revisions.zh: 社会保障是能赢得选票的议题。在最后几天，我们必须揭穿约翰逊对我们立场的谎言，反过来让他陷入被动。

revisions.source: I would like to remind civil rights conscious voters that I was fighting for civil rights long before they were popular, as well as helping found the Arizona Chapter of the NAACP.
revisions.zh: 我想提醒关心民权的选民：早在民权还不受欢迎时，我就已为之奋斗，还帮助建立了全国有色人种协进会的亚利桑那州分会。

revisions.source: We need whoever we can get.
revisions.zh: 能争取到谁，我们就需要谁。

revisions.source: Goddamn it.
revisions.zh: 真他妈的。

revisions.source: Hubert Humphrey is an extremist and a socialist. We cannot let this man be one heartbeat away from the Presidency.
revisions.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱是个极端分子，是个社会主义者。我们不能让这个人离总统职位仅有一次心跳之遥。

revisions.source: We should avoid talking about Humphrey. It’s in poor taste.
revisions.zh: 我们应该避免谈论汉弗莱。这样做不够得体。

revisions.source: Want to know who's at fault for this Civil Rights Act? It's Hubert Horatio Humphrey.
revisions.zh: 想知道这项《民权法案》该怪谁吗？就是休伯特·霍雷肖·汉弗莱。

revisions.source: Goldwater’s record on Social Security has always been in support of the program. This is dirty politics from Johnson.
revisions.zh: 戈德华特在社会保障问题上，一贯支持这项制度。这是约翰逊的肮脏政治手段。

revisions.source: We need to clarify- Goldwater only advocates reforming Social Security into a voluntary program.
revisions.zh: 我们需要澄清：戈德华特只是主张，把社会保障改革为自愿参加的制度。

revisions.source: Let’s counter-attack Johnson on the inflation issue. This hurts the Social Security program more than anything I’ve proposed.
revisions.zh: 我们来反击约翰逊的通胀问题。它对社会保障制度的伤害，比我的任何提议都大。

revisions.source: We should talk about states rights' and the Democrats plan to destroy the 10th amendment.
revisions.zh: 我们应该谈州权，以及民主党人摧毁第十修正案的计划。

revisions.source: Let us talk about fiscal conservatism and our plans to reduce inflation.
revisions.zh: 我们来谈财政保守主义，以及我们降低通胀的计划。

revisions.source: Johnson’s weak point is the Bobby Baker case. Let’s talk about Baker and Billy Sol Estes.
revisions.zh: 约翰逊的弱点是博比·贝克案。我们来谈贝克和比利·索尔·埃斯蒂斯。
